name: Cheshire
source:
A supporting character. The cat is a cat, coming and going as she wants. Shackles adorn her limbs from an imprisonment known yet unknown to Alice. While she has features of a human, her eyes and grin are like those of a beast.

Is this cat a friend or foe?

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/who-is-the-red-queen/]official website[/url]]
